currentUserGoal: Fix the still-harsh grass touching SFX on the live desktop/web app while keeping the improved mobile sound feel.
changesMade: Stopped the normal running WebAudio grass touch path from layering the generated fallback sample on top of every touch.
Reduced desktop/web grass touch transient and crunch gain so the sound reads more like a soft brush than amplified white noise.
Lowered high-frequency snap and crunch filters, softened filter Q, slowed noise attack slightly, and replaced the small square overtone with a quieter sine overtone.
Reduced first-touch and crit accent noise levels so browser unlock and crit taps are less sharp.
Softened the generated fallback sample used before WebAudio is running by lowering grit, clicks, crackle, drive, playback rate, and volume.
verificationRun: npm run build passed locally and produced dist/assets/index-CWCsZEWx.js.
